news.title: MANKIND: Subsidiary Exit And Firm Margins Will Support Further Upside
news.body: Mankind Pharma's analyst price target has been adjusted slightly higher from ₹2,506.53 to ₹2,515.74 as analysts update their assumptions around revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E expectations. What's in the News The board is scheduled to meet on April 13, 2026, at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review corporate matters, including the subsidiary structure (company filing).

news.title: MANKIND: Subsidiary Closure Decision Will Support Future Re Rating Potential
news.body: Analysts have made a slight trim to the price target for Mankind Pharma, with fair value moving from ₹3,100.00 to about ₹3,085.68 as they refresh assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E levels. What's in the News The board plans to meet on Apr 13, 2026, at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review and approve the closure of Mankind Pharma Lanka Private Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary in Sri Lanka, following changes in local regulatory requirements (Key Developments).

news.title: MANKIND: Upcoming Results And Solid Margins Will Support Further Upside
news.body: Analysts have cut their price target on Mankind Pharma by ₹30 to reflect slightly lower assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples, resulting in a modest reset in fair value expectations. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on Feb 3, 2026 at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, along with the Limited Review Report (Key Developments).

news.title: MANKIND: Upcoming Board Review And Steady Assumptions Will Support Bullish Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have kept Mankind Pharma's fair value estimate unchanged at ₹3,100 per share, citing slightly higher assumptions for revenue growth at 14.04% and profit margin at 21.31%, along with a marginally lower future P/E of 41.44x. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 03, 2026 at 15:00 IST to review and approve unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, along with the Limited Review Report (company filing).

news.title: MANKIND: Upcoming Results And Firmer Margins Will Support Bullish Re-Rating

What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on February 3, 2026, at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, along with the Limited Review Report (Key Developments).

news.title: MANKIND: Upcoming Results Will Support Further Upside Despite Modest Assumption Cuts
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Mankind Pharma from about ₹2,631 to about ₹2,537. This reflects slightly lower assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples, alongside a modestly reduced discount rate.

news.title: MANKIND: Fair Value Outlook Will Reflect Lower Growth And Higher Margins
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Mankind Pharma from ₹2,150 to ₹1,990, citing updates to revenue growth, profit margin and assumed future P/E levels in their revised models. What's in the News Mankind Pharma has scheduled a board meeting on Feb 03, 2026, at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, along with the Limited Review Report (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.90 (up from ₹9.45 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹35.7b (up 10% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.09b (up 7.5% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 18%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.

news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Mankind Pharma from ₹3,260 to ₹3,110, citing slightly softer revenue growth expectations, partly offset by firmer profit margin and P/E assumptions. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on Feb 03, 2026 to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025 (company filing).
